2609.02391.title: PolERo: Studying Political Evasion in Romanian
2609.02391.paper_summary: Political evasion refers to responses that engage with a question while withholding the requested information. Recent NLP work frames political evasion as a classification task using a two-level taxonomy of response clarity and fine-grained evasion strategies. Existing work on response clarity and evasion classification is limited to English, leaving open whether the taxonomy and model behavior transfer across languages and political contexts. We introduce PolERo, a dataset of 3,574 human-annotated question-answer pairs extracted from official transcripts of five Romanian presidents. We evaluate multiple classification approaches on both datasets under matched conditions, including TF-IDF baselines, fine-tuned encoder models, a proposed sliding-window encoder, and zero/few-shot LLM prompting. We study cross-lingual transfer through joint bilingual training and machine-translation-based data augmentation. Our results indicate that fine-tuned encoders are competitive, cross-lingual transfer is asymmetric, and ambivalent evasion categories involving pragmatic cues remain the main challenge across all model families.
2609.02391.paper_summary_zh: 政治逃避指的是在回應問題時，雖然參與了討論，但卻隱瞞所要求的信息。最近的自然語言處理研究將政治逃避框架化為一個分類任務，使用了兩級的回應清晰度和細緻的逃避策略分類法。現有的回應清晰度和逃避分類的研究僅限於英語，尚未探討該分類法和模型行為是否能跨語言和政治背景轉移。我們介紹了PolERo，一個包含3,574對人類標註的問題-回答對的數據集，這些對話摘自五位羅馬尼亞總統的官方記錄。我們在匹配條件下對兩個數據集評估了多種分類方法，包括TF-IDF基準、微調的編碼器模型、一個提議的滑動窗口編碼器，以及零/少樣本的LLM提示。我們通過聯合雙語訓練和基於機器翻譯的數據增強來研究跨語言轉移。我們的結果表明，微調的編碼器具有競爭力，跨語言轉移是不對稱的，涉及語用線索的曖昧逃避類別仍然是所有模型家族面臨的主要挑戰。
2609.02391.author: Gabriel Stefan et.al.
